data.title: 五河琴里 · 晨曦软被中的猫咪甜梦
data.description: 早晨纯白被窝里暖意融融，琴里像只小奶猫一样整个人钻在你的怀中，雪白幼嫩的香肩贴在你的胸膛上。眼睫轻颤、嘴角带着满足至极的甜笑，在朝阳中呢喃着一辈子的爱。
data.location: bright morning bedroom filled with sunshine
data.action: completely tangled in white morning sheets with bare shoulders exposed, snuggled tightly against partner chest like a kitten, murmuring sweet lover confessions with blissful flushed smile
data.lighting: radiant golden morning sunbeams pouring across white bedspread
data.mood: angelic morning peace, sweet possessive girlfriend cuddles, supreme domestic joy
data.promptProse: Tangled in white morning duvet with flushed bare shoulders, Kotori Itsuka snuggles tightly against partner chest with a blissful kitten smile.
